Oink 0.3.2 lets you use Oink at the Windows sign-in screen and fixes several bugs that could get in the way.

## New

- Use Oink at the Windows sign-in screen: when Launch at login is on, your other devices can also control the sign-in screen that appears after Windows starts.
- "Take the foreground when the pointer leaves" on Windows is now off by default. You can turn it back on in Settings.

## Fixes

- Fixed keys typed on a Windows computer not reaching the other computer after the pointer moved there when "Take the foreground when the pointer leaves" was on; an input method box could appear on the Windows computer instead.
- Fixed images dragged from another computer into Chrome and other browsers on Windows failing to load.
- Fixed a Mac sometimes staying offline until Oink was restarted, after macOS stopped Oink's network connection (for example, when VPN or security software changed network settings).
- Fixed apps opened on Windows while the pointer was on another computer losing focus or minimizing (for example, fullscreen games) when the pointer came back.
- Fixed a newly paired computer or newly connected screen sometimes being hidden in the layout until you showed it manually.
- Fixed Oink's background process crashing on Windows when starting some drags.
- When Oink's background process fails to start on Windows, Oink now shows the reason and exit code.

## Compatibility

- 0.3.2 works with 0.3.0 and later.

## Downloads

- **Mac:** the `.dmg` file — Apple silicon, macOS 14.2 or later.
- **Windows:** the `.msi` file — x64, Windows 10 22H2 (build 19045) or later, or Windows 11.
